title: His Everything
story:
A young boy was playing in a large garden.

He ran freely.

He picked flowers.

He enjoyed the beauty around him.

He felt like it was all his.

After some time, an old man approached him.

The boy became nervous.

He thought he had done something wrong.

But the man smiled gently.

“This is my garden,” he said.

The boy lowered his head.

“I am sorry. I thought…”

The man interrupted him kindly.

“I am glad you enjoyed it.”

“Everything here belongs to me.”

“But you are welcome to enjoy it.”

“Just take care of it.”

The boy looked around again.

This time, he saw things differently.

Not as an owner.

But as a caretaker.

In life, we often think what we have is ours.

Our time.

Our money.

Our abilities.

But everything belongs to God.

He created it all.

He owns it all.

We are simply stewards.

When we understand this,

we live with gratitude.

We live with responsibility.

And we honor Him in all we do.
life_lesson:
Everything you have belongs to God.

Live as a faithful steward, not as an owner.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for everything You have given me.

Help me to remember that all things belong to You.

Teach me to be a good steward of my time, resources, and abilities.

Give me a heart of gratitude.

Help me to honor You in all I do.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you see your life as something you own or something entrusted by God?

How are you using what God has given you?

What is one area where you can be a better steward today?
verse:
The earth is the Lord’s, and everything in it.
The world, and all who live in it.
